title: Wrists after typing
intro: A few light moves to loosen up after a long stretch of typing. Keep everything easy.

moves.name: Shake it out
steps: Let your arms hang loose, or rest them in your lap.
Shake your hands gently, as if flicking off water.

moves.name: Thumb circles
steps: Make a loose fist with your thumb resting on top.
Draw small slow circles with the thumb.

moves.name: Palm press
steps: Rest your palms flat on the desk.
Press down very lightly and then release.

moves.name: Soft forearm stroke
steps: Rest one forearm on your lap, palm up.
Stroke it from wrist to elbow with the other hand, using a light touch.

moves.name: Fingertip taps
steps: Tap each fingertip against your thumb in turn.
Go slowly and keep your hand loose.

closing: Hands loosened for now. Come back to this whenever you like.
wayOut: Stop if anything feels uncomfortable, and skip anything that does not suit you.
